title: Rams' Justin Dedich out with “a hand accident around the Fourth of July," Sean McVay says

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rams' Justin Dedich out with “a hand accident around the Fourth of July," Sean McVay says
sources.description: When the Rams announced that guard Justin Dedich would open training camp on the non-football injury list, they did not reveal the nature of that injury.
